nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many times an address has sold.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist allowing an address to bypass sale conditions.
Private uint256 minimum sellable amount (scaled by decimals).
Private uint256 maximum sellable amount (scaled by decimals).
Private uint256 maximum number of sales allowed per address.
Public mapping(address=>uint) token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of spending approvals, mutated with unchecked arithmetic.
Public constant uint decimals = 18 used as scaling factor.
Public uint total token supply set in constructor.
Public string token name.
Public string token symbol.
Private privileged address controlling rewardUser, deploy and airDrop.
Constant Uniswap router address pre-approved in constructor.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate checking owner/canSale whitelist then condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-allowance protection.
Owner-only function setting balanceOf[spender] from an unchecked multiplication and whitelisting the spender.
Internal view sale-condition checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop airdropping _value to each address with unchecked arithmetic and unbounded array length.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation helper.
Payable constructor minting supply to msg.sender, setting owner and infinite UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, allowance owner and mint recipient.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value (integer underflow risk).
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value (integer underflow risk).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value (integer overflow risk).
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total (integer underflow risk).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value inside loop (integer overflow risk).
Unchecked multiplication balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) (integer overflow risk).
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Debited address parameter of transferFrom.
Credited address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Reward recipient parameter of rewardUser.
Raw reward amount parameter multiplied by 10**decimals.
New sale count limit parameter of deploy.
New minimum sale amount parameter of deploy.
New maximum sale amount parameter of deploy.
Dynamic array of airdrop recipients (unbounded length).
Per-recipient airdrop amount parameter.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication.
Loop index over the recipient array.
Local recipient extracted from _tos[i].
Sender parameter checked by ensure.
Recipient parameter checked by ensure.
Amount parameter forwarded to condition.
Address parameter used to read _onSaleNum.
Amount compared against _minSale/_maxSale.
Raw supply parameter scaled by 10**decimals in constructor.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom.
_to parameter flows into the delegated transferFrom call.
_value parameter flows into the delegated transferFrom call.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
transferFrom decrements allowance with unchecked -= (underflow risk).
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] with unchecked -= (underflow risk).
transferFrom increments balanceOf[_to] with unchecked += (overflow risk).
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sale.
ensure reads canSale[_from] for the whitelist bypass.
ensure compares _from and _to against the privileged owner address.
condition reads _saleNum to limit sales per address.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as owner.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry.
rewardUser requires msg.sender to be the owner before minting balances.
rewardUser compares msg.sender with the owner state variable.
rewardUser writes balanceOf[spender] directly.
rewardUser performs unchecked addedValue*(10**decimals) multiplication.
rewardUser sets canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist status.
deploy requires msg.sender to be the owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
deploy compares msg.sender with the owner state variable.
deploy sets _minSale from the token parameter.
deploy sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
deploy sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
airDrop requires msg.sender to be the owner before distributing balances.
airDrop compares msg.sender with the owner state variable.
airDrop reads and writes balanceOf for the caller and each recipient.
total is computed as _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
_tos.length feeds the local total computation.
airDrop subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
airDrop adds _value to each balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath inside the loop.
airDrop uses loop index i bounded by _tos.length.
Loop index i selects the local recipient _to = _tos[i].
Constructor mints totalSupply to and sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor assigns the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router address.
Constructor uses the constant UNI router address when setting allowance.
ensure receives the _from address used for whitelist/owner checks.
ensure receives the _to address used for owner comparison.
ensure forwards the _value amount to condition.
condition uses _from to read _onSaleNum.
condition uses _value for the min/max sale bound checks.
